categories.evidence: Modifies `ci/test/03_test_script.sh` to prevent IWYU CI jobs from silently ignoring compiler failures.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading CI passes by ensuring fatal compiler errors in the IWYU job fail the build instead of being masked by `|| true`. Closes #35361 after prerequisite header generation fixes were merged, restoring signal to the CI check.
